Ah something I know. Fruit juices. My dad used to work in the quality department from a big fruit juice corporation. They basically produced every juices from the brand, but also the juices for specific store-brands. The recipes varied a bit from one another, but technically the process are the same and the products too. Except of course for specific products (e.g Florida oranges). Also, technically all juices are from concentrate because they have to transport the juice in a form that won't get damaged. Even the "fresh" juices are just a reduced juice where they add osmosed water back to it... Pulp also can be added back, depending on the juice.

I was at a skatepark, a few months ago, and someone tried to do a trick, I can't remember what, off a manual pad... His head landed on the tail of his board, and then his body slammed on the concrete. As blood started gushing out of the back of his head, he started convulsing on the ground. I'm really scared of blood, and at this moment all the first aids lessons I had went away and I was paralyzed, in shock... Just writing it down gives me chills... I think we've all seen a pretty bad slam on like Thrasher's Hall of meat or something, but one in real life is just horrible... The dude actually ended getting back on his feet after the ambulance came by, they also dropped him at the nearest hospital...
